source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; page undated (references Shutterstock acquisition of Envato "effective May 2024," placing publication post-July 2024)
snippet_primary: "Although it may not have the sheer volume of content that Shutterstock offers, Envato is still a solid choice for designers and developers looking for all-inclusive pricing and unlimited access to high-quality creative tools. If your projects focus on design templates or specific creative assets, Envato may be the right fit, but for those seeking a broader range of high-quality content, Shutterstock remains the more versatile platform."
subject_exact: author comparison of Envato versus Shutterstock content volume and suitability by project type
